historical_record.description: An existing two-story over basement commercial building stood at the property, with approximately 1,800 square feet of vacant commercial retail space at the basement level.

The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization to convert approximately 1,800 square feet of vacant commercial retail space at the basement level to a retail wine and gift store at 2118 Union Street.
